title: A Snapshot of Forever
description: Wedding photographer Jessie Brookes' happy life in her small town is changed when a famous Hollywood actor attends her sister's wedding.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E16 — Man in a Hurry
Malcolm Tucker, a wealthy businessman, has trouble getting his car to start and finds himself stranded in Mayberry on a Sunday.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E17 — High Noon in Mayberry
Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E18 — The Loaded Goat
Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E19 — Class Reunion
Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E20 — Rafe Hollister Sings
Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E21 — Opie and the Spoiled Kid
Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E22 — The Great Filling Station Robbery
Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E23 — Andy Discovers America
Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E24 — Aunt Bee's Medicine Man
Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E25 — The Darlings Are Coming
Andy unexpectedly has his hands full as The Darlings, a family of musicians from the mountains, arrive in Mayberry to meet a bus due the next day.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E26 — Andy's English Valet
Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E27 — Barney's First Car
Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.

title: A Cozy Christmas Quilt
description: Liam and Amy team up to make a Christmas quilt for Liam's sister's wedding.

title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
description: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker."

title: A Very Curious Christmas
description: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E28 — The Rivals
After Opie is struck with puppy love, Barney tries to show him how to handle women.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E29 — A Wife for Andy
Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E30 — Dogs, Dogs, Dogs
A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E31 — Mountain Wedding
The Darling family returns to Mayberry and asks Andy for help in dealing with Ernest T. Bass, a mountain man who keeps pursuing Briscoe's married daughter Charlene.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E32 — The Big House
Barney and Gomer are responsible for watching over two thieves who are temporarily jailed in Mayberry. Between the two of them, the criminals manage to escape three times.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E01 — Opie the Birdman
Opie takes on the job of raising three baby birds after he accidentally kills the mother bird and learns important life lessons along the way.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E02 — The Haunted House
Andy, Barney, and Gomer look for a lost baseball while exploring a supposedly haunted house and experience some strange events inside.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E03 — Ernest T. Bass Joins the Army
Mountain man Ernest T. Bass goes on a window-breaking ruckus around town after the army refuses to accept him in their ranks. When Andy and Barney arrest him, he explains to them that he wants a uniform to attract women.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E04 — The Sermon for Today
A preacher urges the residents of Mayberry to relax and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E05 — Briscoe Declares for Aunt Bee
Briscoe Darling decides to court and marry Aunt Bee after he is treated to her hospitality and home cooking. When he resorts to kidnapping, Andy rescues Aunt Bee and convinces her to make Briscoe work hard to clean up their home.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E06 — Gomer the House Guest
Gomer moves in with Andy after he loses his job at the filling station. Before long, the Taylor house turns into another filling station as Gomer's customers line up to get their cars looked at in Andy's driveway.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E07 — A Black Day for Mayberry
Barney lets it slip that a top-secret shipment of gold will make its way through Mayberry on the way to Fort Knox. Everyone in town soon knows about the gold and welcomes it with a carnival-like reception.

title: Divine Influencer
description: An influencer loses everything when her parents cut her off; homeless, she soon learns the meaning of true influence.

title: Nothing Is Impossible
description: Comedian Dayo Wong and Cherrie Yin star in a romantic comedy.

title: Strong Fathers, Strong Daughters
description: When a wealthy businessman learns of his daughter's engagement, he struggles to give up control and trust God with her future.

title: The Abigail Mysteries
description: Struggling to come to terms with loss, Abby Brooks goes on a journey of faith, reconnection and adventure as she works with a local cop and childhood crush, Matt, to solve a mystery.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E04 — The Mill
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E05 — The Hopefuls
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E06 — Denver McKee
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E09 — Breed of Violence
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E10 — The Last Viking
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E11 — The Trail Gang
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E12 — The Savage
Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E13 — Silent Thunder
Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E14 — The Ape
Adam and Little Joe warn Hoss when he tries to help Arnie, a man with the mind of a child and an uncontrollable temper.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E15 — The Blood Line
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E16 — The Courtship
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E17 — The Spitfire
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E19 — The Gunmen
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E20 — The Fear Merchants
A potential mayoral candidate attempts to stir up trouble between majority and minority groups in town.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E21 — Spanish Grant
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E23 — Desert Justice
A Ponderosa ranch hand faces charges of killing the wife of the U.S. marshal who came to arrest him.
